arm_model: common marginal development shape for both arms; no arm-specific retention observations
cost_note: Fixed N is retained as mandated by the spec: 96 paired terminal worlds, plus 16 product sessions and timing, with all arms completing. Sequential illustration has looks 16/32, alpha .025 per look (Bonferroni across looks, conservative Holm rank), no futility, and early success only with point mass>=40, positive LB and survival bands. Saved worlds are an optimistic ceiling: product/timing bars and the second arm can prevent stopping; look overhead is omitted. It is not a proposed or authorized execution schedule. At a true +40 effect, the point>=40 clause alone has about 50% power even when sign power is high.
limitations: No retention outcomes or precheck outcomes were read. This is design evidence, not efficacy.
No development paired retention data cover frozen or mixed terminal rosters. Scripted T3 shape is a proxy.
T3 source arms share 32 physical seeds, use different checkpoints and are separate sensitivity pools.
T15 and T13b Watch baselines are separate 25-session continuous-respawn development sources; neither is a paired candidate outcome or terminal survival.

Original regression/stress diagnostics use additive centered survival shifts which can leave [0,1]. The new Path B power grid uses bounded alive fractions and binary no-death rescue coupled to full-horizon survival.
Normal stress is a declared distribution model; it is not additional observed worlds.
Wilson intervals report Monte Carlo uncertainty; acceptance uses amendment's point-rate <=.06 criterion.

The original regression diagnostics omit other contract clauses. Path B joint power uses conservative Holm first-rank alpha .05 and models no-death and product death CIs; true arm dependence, timing and boost are not measured, and product growth is assumed unchanged.
Product power uses a declared binomial thinning counterfactual. It does not estimate a controller effect, account for product overdispersion, or authorize a product result or change to N=16.

methods.centering: T3 mass and alive deltas centered separately; joint shape retained within worlds
methods.empirical: each 32-world arm resampled separately; scripted shape reused as proxy for all mixes
methods.joint: mass plus band only, all other bars assumed pass; upper bound for complete GO probability
methods.mass: one-sided LB at alpha .10 and conservative two-arm Holm first rank .05; point >=40
methods.near_zero: raw near-zero frequency is a diagnostic; complete passing mass/band cells are retained under the corrected mass-only exception
methods.pathb_power: T3 centered dense within-world mass/alive shape, scripted-only survival gains +.10/+.25, all-mix mass gains +40/+60/+92, fixed N=32 per mix
methods.pooling: independent mix draws, equal-mix Welch-Satterthwaite, paired world unit
methods.product_power: 16 paired Watch6 sessions; independently resample each historical baseline and apply binomial death thinning at 20%/40%, two-sided paired Student-t 95% CI
methods.rng: NumPy PCG64 SeedSequence([seed, completed_batch_offset]); batch size 250
methods.stress: independent normal survival SD .25/.35/.50; mass SD sqrt(2)*Watch baseline mean-length SD
methods.survival: one-look alpha=.05, strict pooled LB>-0.05 and every mix LB>-0.075; floor .30

pathb_joint_go_power.interpretation: Joint paced-arm skill plus product GO probability: fixed-N terminal bars include the two-arm Holm first-rank mass threshold, survival floors, and scripted no-death >=.03; each product baseline uses the 16-session paired death CI. Timing, boost, and product growth are assumed to pass.

t3_like_power_review_required.rule: Report below-.5 joint power; fixed N=32/mix does not change.

watch6_product_power.criterion: paired two-sided 95% Student-t CI upper endpoint for deaths/1k is <0
watch6_product_power.interpretation: Separate T15 and T13b mixed-Watch6 baseline sensitivities; simulated candidate death thinning is a development model, not product efficacy evidence.
